game.name: Hocus Pocus
game.desc: Hocus Pocus is Moonlite Software's 1994 side-scrolling platformer published by Apogee. The apprentice wizard Hocus must clear each castle of its crystals and monsters to earn a seat on the Council of Wizards, across four episodes of nine levels with switches, keys, elevators, teleports and end-of-level bonuses for speed and treasure. This port includes the shareware episode and takes the registered game files for the other three.
